name: Jupiter Perpetual Exchange
description: Jupiter Perpetual Exchange is a LP-to-trader perpetual exchange based on oracle prices.
methodology: TVL sums each Custody's tokenAccount SPL balance (LP liquidity plus trader collateral held in the same custody token account) plus Custody.totalStakedAmountLamports (the SOL custody's natively-staked portion held in Solana stake accounts). Borrowed is Custody.debt/1e9 per asset — USDC lent out to JLP-loan borrowers, fully collateralized by JLP, reported separately.
